title: Three Young Women, Wooden Timber Structure - Vintage 1960s B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A vintage square black-and-white snapshot stamped 'AUG 66' on the top border. Three young women pose on a sunlit, rugged hillside next to a rudimentary timber structure or shelter under construction. One smiling woman in trousers and a short-sleeved blouse holds a support beam, flanked by two friends dressed in mid-1960s casual attire. The background features rocky ground, lumber, and an exposed rocky bank.
